question:
Spot the error.

The little girl, who has been learning classical music since the age of five, (A) / sings very sweet (B) / and has won several prizes in inter-school competitions. (C)

options.text: The little girl, who has been learning classical music since the age of five,
and has won several prizes in inter-school competitions.

explanation: Verb (sings) को modify करने के लिए adverb चाहिए: 'sweet' → 'sweetly'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

At the annual function of the college, the chief guest looked [gracefully] in her traditional silk saree.
explanation: Linking verb (look, feel, taste, smell, sound, seem) के बाद adjective आता है: 'looked graceful'।

question:
Spot the error.

Everyone who attended the family function appreciated the dinner, (A) / and the curry that my grandmother prepared (B) / tastes deliciously even after two days. (C)

options.text: Everyone who attended the family function appreciated the dinner,
and the curry that my grandmother prepared
tastes deliciously even after two days.

explanation: Sense verbs (taste, smell, look, feel) के बाद adjective आता है: 'tastes delicious'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The roses growing in the old garden of the palace smell [sweetly] early in the morning, when the dew is still fresh.
explanation: 'Smell' linking verb है, इसके बाद adjective आता है: 'smell sweet'।

question:
Spot the error.

Although the question paper was far tougher than expected, (A) / a large number of students in the batch (B) / did very good and scored above eighty per cent marks. (C)

options.text: Although the question paper was far tougher than expected,
a large number of students in the batch
did very good and scored above eighty per cent marks.

explanation: Verb (did) को modify करने के लिए adverb 'well' आता है: 'did very well'।

question:
Spot the error.

The young farmer works so hardly in his fields (A) / from dawn to dusk that he has (B) / no time left to spend with his family. (C)

options.text: The young farmer works so hardly in his fields
from dawn to dusk that he has
no time left to spend with his family.

explanation: 'Hard' adjective और adverb दोनों है ('कड़ी मेहनत से'); 'hardly' का अर्थ 'मुश्किल से/लगभग नहीं' है। सही: 'works so hard'।

question:
Spot the error.

On the occasion of Makar Sankranti, thousands of colourful kites flew highly (A) / in the clear blue sky above (B) / the narrow lanes of the old city of Ahmedabad. (C)

options.text: On the occasion of Makar Sankranti, thousands of colourful kites flew highly
in the clear blue sky above
the narrow lanes of the old city of Ahmedabad.

explanation: 'High' का adverb रूप भी 'high' है ('ऊँचाई पर'); 'highly' का अर्थ 'अत्यधिक/बहुत' होता है: 'flew high'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

Because of the heavy traffic jam on the highway, the Chief Minister reached the venue of the rally [lately] by almost two hours.
explanation: 'Late' का अर्थ 'देर से' है; 'lately' का अर्थ 'हाल ही में' होता है: 'reached ... late'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The principal insisted that the students should be allowed to express their opinions [free] without any fear of punishment.
explanation: Verb (express) को modify करने के लिए adverb 'freely' आता है; 'free' adjective है।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The accident occurred [nearly] the railway crossing at about midnight, when most of the villagers were asleep.
explanation: 'Near' (पास) और 'nearly' (लगभग) में अंतर है: 'occurred near the railway crossing'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The film directed by the young filmmaker was [wide] acclaimed by critics across the world and won several international awards.
explanation: 'Acclaimed' (participle) को modify करने के लिए adverb 'widely' आता है।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The scientists were asked to watch the experiment [close] and to record every change that occurred in the chemical solution.
explanation: Verb (watch) को modify करने के लिए adverb 'closely' आता है; 'close' का अर्थ 'पास' है।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The old man was so [deep] moved by the tragic incident that tears began to roll down his cheeks.
explanation: 'Moved' को modify करने के लिए adverb 'deeply' आता है।

question:
Spot the error.

The condition of the patient who had been admitted to the hospital last week (A) / is very better (B) / than it was on the day of admission. (C)

options.text: The condition of the patient who had been admitted to the hospital last week
than it was on the day of admission.

explanation: 'Very' comparative degree के साथ नहीं लगता; 'much/far/a lot' लगता है: 'much better'।

question:
Spot the error.

The retired professor was too happy (A) / to see his former students after almost thirty years (B) / and he invited all of them to his house. (C)

options.text: The retired professor was too happy
to see his former students after almost thirty years
and he invited all of them to his house.

explanation: 'Too' नकारात्मक अर्थ (अत्यधिक, जिससे काम न हो) देता है; सकारात्मक भाव के लिए 'very' आता है: 'very happy to see'।

question:
Spot the error.

It is too much hot in the desert areas of Rajasthan (A) / during the months of May and June, (B) / so people avoid going out in the afternoon. (C)

options.text: It is too much hot in the desert areas of Rajasthan
during the months of May and June,
so people avoid going out in the afternoon.

explanation: 'Too much' noun/verb के साथ आता है; adjective के साथ 'much too' आता है: 'much too hot'।

question:
Spot the error.

The lecture delivered by the visiting professor was a quite interesting one (A) / and the audience applauded warmly (B) / at the end of the session. (C)

options.text: The lecture delivered by the visiting professor was a quite interesting one
at the end of the session.

explanation: 'Quite' का स्थान 'a/an' से पहले होता है: 'quite an interesting one'।

question:
Spot the error.

The candidate who appeared for the interview yesterday morning (A) / is sufficiently intelligent enough (B) / to handle such a responsible position. (C)

options.text: The candidate who appeared for the interview yesterday morning
to handle such a responsible position.

explanation: 'Sufficiently' और 'enough' का एक साथ प्रयोग redundancy है: 'sufficiently intelligent' या 'intelligent enough'।

question:
Spot the error.

The selection committee felt that the candidate, (A) / despite his impressive academic record, was not (B) / enough qualified to handle such a complex project. (C)

options.text: The selection committee felt that the candidate,
despite his impressive academic record, was not
enough qualified to handle such a complex project.

explanation: 'Enough' adjective के बाद आता है: 'not qualified enough'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The students like their new English teacher [very] because of his friendly nature and his unique style of teaching.
explanation: 'Very' verb को modify नहीं करता; verb के साथ 'very much' आता है: 'like ... very much'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The teacher explained the theorem [so clearly that] even the weakest students in the class could understand it.
explanation: 'So + adverb + that' (परिणाम) सही है, इसलिए कोई सुधार नहीं।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The new smartphone is [far more] expensive than the previous model, but it has a much better camera.
explanation: 'Far/much' comparative को modify कर सकते हैं: 'far more expensive'। इसलिए कोई सुधार नहीं।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The young sprinter can run [as faster as] any other athlete in the national training camp.
explanation: 'As ... as' के बीच adverb की मूल (positive) degree आती है: 'as fast as'।

question:
Spot the error.

The new generation of electric cars can accelerate more faster (A) / than the conventional vehicles (B) / that are powered by petrol or diesel engines. (C)

options.text: The new generation of electric cars can accelerate more faster
that are powered by petrol or diesel engines.

explanation: 'Faster' पहले से comparative है, इसलिए 'more' के साथ double comparative नहीं बनता: 'accelerate faster'।

question:
Spot the error.

The young cricketer is old enough to understand the consequences of his actions, (A) / and he has already decided (B) / to take full responsibility for the defeat. (C)

options.text: The young cricketer is old enough to understand the consequences of his actions,
to take full responsibility for the defeat.

explanation: 'Old enough' में 'enough' adjective के बाद सही स्थान पर है और 'already' affirmative वाक्य में सही है। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

The foreign guest speaks Hindi quite fluently, (A) / but he writes it (B) / rather poorly. (C)

options.text: The foreign guest speaks Hindi quite fluently,

explanation: 'Quite fluently' और 'rather poorly' दोनों adverbs सही स्थान पर हैं। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

My uncle, who retired from the railways nearly two years ago, (A) / goes always for a long walk (B) / in the nearby park before sunrise. (C)

options.text: My uncle, who retired from the railways nearly two years ago,
goes always for a long walk
in the nearby park before sunrise.

explanation: Frequency adverb (always, never, often, usually) main verb से पहले आता है: 'always goes'।

question:
Spot the error.

The poor labourer never complained to anybody about the hardships he faced (A) / and never did nothing (B) / to harm his employer. (C)

options.text: The poor labourer never complained to anybody about the hardships he faced

explanation: 'Never' के साथ 'nothing' से double negative बनता है: 'never did anything'।

question:
Spot the error.

After paying the huge hospital bills of his father, (A) / the family of the clerk was left (B) / with scarcely no money to buy food for the week. (C)

options.text: After paying the huge hospital bills of his father,
the family of the clerk was left
with scarcely no money to buy food for the week.

explanation: 'Scarcely' खुद negative अर्थ रखता है, इसलिए 'no' के साथ double negative बनता है: 'scarcely any money'।

question:
Spot the error.

The search party looked for the missing trekkers (A) / in the dense forest for three days, (B) / but could not find them nowhere. (C)

options.text: The search party looked for the missing trekkers
in the dense forest for three days,
but could not find them nowhere.

explanation: 'Could not' के साथ 'nowhere' से double negative बनता है: 'could not find them anywhere'।

question:
Spot the error.

Almost people living in the coastal villages of the state (A) / depend on fishing and related activities (B) / for their livelihood throughout the year. (C)

options.text: Almost people living in the coastal villages of the state
depend on fishing and related activities
for their livelihood throughout the year.

explanation: 'Most people' (अधिकांश लोग) सही है; 'almost' का अर्थ 'लगभग' है और वह इस तरह noun से पहले नहीं आता: 'Most people living ...'।

question:
Spot the error.

The meeting of the cabinet, which lasted for nearly five hours, (A) / was a highly confidential one and (B) / besides the Prime Minister nobody other was present. (C)

options.text: The meeting of the cabinet, which lasted for nearly five hours,
was a highly confidential one and
besides the Prime Minister nobody other was present.

explanation: 'Nobody' के बाद 'else' आता है, 'other' नहीं: 'nobody else was present'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The old professor does not live in this locality [no longer], and nobody in the neighbourhood knows his present address.
explanation: 'No longer' के साथ 'not' से double negative बनता है; 'not ... any longer' आता है: 'does not live here any longer'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

Dr. Sharma is the most generous person I have [never] met in my entire career as a journalist.
explanation: Superlative के बाद 'ever' आता है, 'never' नहीं: 'the most generous person I have ever met'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

He could [scarcely believe] his eyes when he saw the result of the examination on the notice board.
explanation: 'Scarcely believe' सही प्रयोग है (scarcely खुद negative है), इसलिए कोई सुधार नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

She has been working extremely hard throughout the year, (A) / and she has hardly taken (B) / any leave since the project began. (C)

options.text: She has been working extremely hard throughout the year,
any leave since the project began.

explanation: 'Extremely hard' (कड़ी मेहनत) और 'hardly taken any leave' (लगभग छुट्टी नहीं ली) दोनों का प्रयोग सही है। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

Although the deadline is only two days away, (A) / the contractor appointed by the municipal corporation (B) / has not already completed even half of the construction work. (C)

options.text: Although the deadline is only two days away,
the contractor appointed by the municipal corporation
has not already completed even half of the construction work.

explanation: Negative वाक्य में 'already' की जगह 'yet' आता है: 'has not yet completed'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The chief engineer [has yet not submitted] the final report on the collapse of the bridge to the ministry.
explanation: 'Yet' negative वाक्य में 'not' के बाद आता है: 'has not yet submitted'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

I told the manager that I had met his brother at the conference in Singapore three years [ago].
explanation: Past Perfect (had met) के साथ 'ago' नहीं, 'before' आता है: 'three years before'।

question:
Spot the error.

The Prime Minister attended the inaugural session of the climate summit (A) / and so the Foreign Minister did (B) / along with several other senior delegates. (C)

options.text: The Prime Minister attended the inaugural session of the climate summit
and so the Foreign Minister did
along with several other senior delegates.

explanation: पुष्टि के लिए 'so' से वाक्य शुरू हो तो inversion आता है: 'and so did the Foreign Minister'।

question:
Spot the error.

Never before in the history of the institution (A) / the students had shown (B) / such remarkable discipline during an examination. (C)

options.text: Never before in the history of the institution
such remarkable discipline during an examination.

explanation: 'Never before' जैसे negative adverbials से वाक्य शुरू हो तो inversion आता है: 'had the students shown'।

question:
Spot the error.

Only after the final results were declared by the university, (A) / the students realised how seriously (B) / they had underestimated the vast syllabus. (C)

options.text: Only after the final results were declared by the university,
they had underestimated the vast syllabus.

explanation: 'Only after' से वाक्य शुरू होने पर main clause में inversion आता है: 'did the students realise'।

question:
Spot the error.

My elder brother does not like travelling by air and I do not like it too (A) / because both of us get dizzy (B) / at great heights. (C)

options.text: My elder brother does not like travelling by air and I do not like it too
because both of us get dizzy

explanation: Negative वाक्य में 'too' की जगह 'either' आता है: 'I do not like it either'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The first batsman did not score a single run in the entire match, and [neither the second batsman did] despite playing three innings.
explanation: 'Neither' से वाक्य शुरू हो तो inversion आता है: 'neither did the second batsman'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

[Little he knew] that the stranger whom he had helped on the road was the new director of his company.
explanation: 'Little' जैसे negative adverb से वाक्य शुरू हो तो inversion आता है: 'Little did he know'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

[Hardly ever does the old man leave] his house after sunset, as he has a very weak heart.

options.text: Hardly ever the old man leaves
Hardly ever leaves the old man
Hardly ever old man does leave

explanation: 'Hardly ever' से वाक्य शुरू होने पर inversion (does the old man leave) सही है, इसलिए कोई सुधार नहीं।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The students were told to [return back] to their classrooms immediately after the lunch break was over.
explanation: 'Return' में 'back' का अर्थ पहले से शामिल है, इसलिए 'return back' redundancy है।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The newly appointed secretary is [equally as capable as] his predecessor and has already won the confidence of the staff.
explanation: 'Equally as' का एक साथ प्रयोग गलत है: 'as capable as' (या 'equally capable')।

question:
Spot the error.

Fortunately, the pilot managed to land the aircraft safely (A) / on the narrow runway (B) / despite the stormy weather and poor visibility. (C)

options.text: Fortunately, the pilot managed to land the aircraft safely
despite the stormy weather and poor visibility.

explanation: 'Fortunately' पूरे वाक्य को modify करने वाला adverb है और 'safely' verb को। दोनों सही हैं। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

It was too late to catch the last train to Lucknow, (A) / so we decided to stay overnight (B) / at a friend's house near the station. (C)

options.text: It was too late to catch the last train to Lucknow,
so we decided to stay overnight
at a friend's house near the station.

explanation: 'Too late to catch' सही structure है। कोई error नहीं।
